程序包 top.brmc.bukkitplatform.zombies.arena.event

类 ArenaEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
top.brmc.devlib.event.SimpleEvent
top.brmc.devlib.event.SimpleCancellableEvent
top.brmc.bukkitplatform.zombies.arena.event.ArenaEvent
直接已知子类:
ArenaCountdownCancelEvent, ArenaCountdownStartEvent, ArenaCountdownTickEvent, ArenaEndEvent, ArenaJoinEvent, ArenaLeaveEvent, ArenaStartEvent, ArenaStateChangeEvent
public abstract class ArenaEvent extends top.brmc.devlib.event.SimpleCancellableEvent
所有竞技场事件的抽象基类.

基于 PluginDevLib 的 SimpleCancellableEvent,因此:

  • 同步/异步自动适配,不会因为异步触发而报错;
  • 全部竞技场事件都带有 cancelled 标记,但只有 ArenaJoinEvent,ArenaLeaveEvent,ArenaStartEvent,ArenaEndEvent 会检查该标记并阻止操作.
